objective: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

description: So the time is once again upon us. As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.
And so now I offer you your question. If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, <name>--there is no pressure to answer quickly.
progress: There is only one rule I feel you must know if you wish to survive in this world: the more you know, the more you'll see.
If you study, if you observe, then you will begin to see things in the world that no other <race> will see.
completion: Well done, <name>. I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.
